snippet.title: Dark Hours - 1.0 Launch Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: In Dark Hours, a heist gone wrong leads to a nightmarish ordeal. Trapped in a haunted auction house, your team of thieves must navigate procedurally generated environments, solve co-op puzzles, and evade a relentless demonic entity. With up to four players, you’ll need to cooperate, manage limited resources, and decide whether to escape or survive until daylight.
